reviews.shade: Torriden Dive-In Soothing Cream 100ml Double Pack (+Sun Serum 20ml)
reviews.text: This is a perfect set that has everything I could ask for. It provides wonderful moisture and is incredibly easy to use. Truly, it's one of the best everyday skincare products on the market!
reviews.zh: 呢套產品真係完美，應有盡有。保濕效果好好，用起嚟極之簡單。真係係市面上最好嘅日常護膚產品之一！

reviews.shade: Torriden Dive-In Soothing Cream 100ml Double Pack (+Sun Serum 20ml)
reviews.text:
Absolutely love Dive In line. The lightest moisturised I've ever tried, perfect for my combination and sensitive skin. Soothes and calms when my acne flares up and hydrates without leaving greasy heavy feeling on my skin. Used the tube to bring on holiday as its easier to carry (although it's over 100ml so mind airport guidance)

Sun serum is amazing too and again perfect dor traveling!
reviews.zh:
真係好鍾意 Dive In 系列。係我用過最輕盈嘅保濕產品，好啱我混合性同敏感皮膚。暗瘡發作嗰陣，佢可以舒緩、令皮膚平靜，而且保濕唔會令皮膚感覺油膩、厚重。我用條管裝去旅行，因為比較方便攜帶（不過超過 100ml，所以要留意機場嘅規定）。

防曬精華都好好，同樣好啱去旅行！

reviews.shade: Torriden Dive-In Soothing Cream 100ml Double Pack (+Sun Serum 20ml)
reviews.text: My day moisturizer. Most likely until the day I die, at least my skin changes too much. The formula is amazing, so light yet so hydrating, it absorbs gorgeously. It’s great under make up, actually is the best formula for under make up I’ve tried so far, and I’ve tried dozens
reviews.zh: 我嘅日間保濕霜。好大可能會用到我離世為止，至少我嘅皮膚都變化得太快。配方好好，輕盈又非常保濕，吸收得好漂亮。喺化妝底下都好好，其實係我至今試過嘅底妝配方當中最好嘅一款，而我試過好多款。

reviews.shade: Torriden Dive-In Soothing Cream 100ml Double Pack (+Sun Serum 20ml)
reviews.text: The cream is light, doesn't make my skin oily, doesn't clog pores, and moisturizes well. I usually prefer a light cream because I apply it after any serum, so my skin doesn't feel tight or have an unpleasant oily feeling.
reviews.zh: 呢款面霜好輕盈，唔會令皮膚出油，唔會阻塞毛孔，保濕效果都好。我通常鍾意輕盈嘅面霜，因為我每次用完精華之後都會塗，咁樣皮膚就唔會感覺緊繃，亦唔會有令人不舒服嘅油膩感。

reviews.shade: Torriden Dive-In Soothing Cream 100ml Double Pack (+Sun Serum 20ml)
reviews.text: Very average and better products exist for less money. Save your money.
reviews.zh: 非常一般，市面上有更好、更平嘅產品。唔好浪費錢。

reviews.shade: Torriden Dive-In Soothing Cream 100ml Double Pack (+Sun Serum 20ml)
reviews.text: Gel consistency and feel very nice on the skin, kind of cooling when first apply to skin. Quickly absorbed, but not very moisturizing as after a while, my skin feels dry.
reviews.zh: 啫喱質地，塗落皮膚感覺好好，第一次塗嗰陣有啲清涼感。吸收好快，但係保濕效果唔算好，因為過咗一陣，我個皮膚就覺得乾。

reviews.shade: Torriden Dive-In Soothing Cream 100ml Double Pack (+Sun Serum 20ml)
reviews.text: I’m in love with this Torriden cream. It’s incredibly hydrating but feels weightless on the skin. It absorbs so fast and leaves my face feeling plump and fresh all day. Perfect for anyone who hates heavy, greasy creams.
reviews.zh: 我超級愛呢款 Torriden 面霜。保濕效果極好，但塗喺皮膚上感覺好似冇重量咁。吸收得好快，令我整日面都飽滿、清新。好啱所有討厭厚重、油膩面霜嘅人。

reviews.shade: Torriden Dive-In Soothing Cream 100ml Double Pack (+Sun Serum 20ml)
reviews.text: Love the dive in collection, most of my products are from this line. So highly recommend. I can ot stress enough the importance of having hydrated skin and how much it can affect its appearance and texture.
reviews.zh: 好鍾意 Dive In 系列，我大部分產品都係呢個系列。所以非常推薦。我點強調都唔為過保持皮膚水潤嘅重要性，以及佢對皮膚外觀同質感嘅影響有幾大。

note: 以下評價由 Olive Young 顧客撰寫，OUJI 原文引用、只加中文翻譯，冇改動內容，亦冇刪走負評。只顯示我哋有貨嘅色號，同價錢有關嘅評價唔會收錄（兩邊售價唔同）。
